source_policy: 普通源行原名/等级/威力/明确目标数保留。未载的最低晋级、学习/升级/施法费、普通十阶段、5%平量阶段成长、动作/范围和名声不作额外门槛为项目设计；V25天地回流9阶段覆盖旧7。源名一/二/三式是不同来源技能名，不自动等同本地技能阶段。
composition: common learning qualification and atomic practice/silver payment apply to phase1; per-ability explicit phases override24single-phase cap/upgrade rejection. Local profiles and phase values override common4L/mana formula, never add source power twice. Known external initial phase1 overrides local timing/cost; explicit external counter remains separately owned.

phase_policy.default_requested_phase: highest learned phase only after explicit player selects ability; a request with phase must be legal learned phase, never silently lower
phase_policy.phase_upgrade: one adjacent phase at a time, same alive/out-of-combat/idle/no-challenge checks; own previous phase, per-phase level/rank, sufficient phase practice/silver; no book/item/ordinary qigong/ascension point cost
phase_policy.maximum_origin: ordinary ten-stage is project selection, except named V25nine-stage; no claim full official phase values have been recovered
phase_policy.power_formula: floor(source_numeric_power*(10000+500*(phase-1))/10000); source number appears once as flat attack or barrier recovery, not4L addition
phase_policy.phase_learning_level: source adopted base level + phase -1; minimum rank remains explicit base rank; skill phase is not character advancement
phase_policy.mana_formula: adopted phase1 mana + phase -1; Zhen phase1 from original内功 integer adopted as mana, others project4+ceil(base_level/5)+2; original3source initial phases preserve22 exact mana
phase_policy.ordinary_reset: ascension reset token does not affect these ordinary phases or return heavenly stones; phase history retains actual practice/silver payments
phase_policy.multi_named_source_skills: different source names with一/二/三式 remain distinct skills under this local graph, learning one never grants another; no automatic predecessor skill dependency beyond own prior phase
phase_policy.invalid_or_missing_phase: reject export/command, no using phase1 as substitute

external_source_rows.scope: existing explicit project single-phase parry graph; no duplicate counter ability/window; unknown official further stages not claimed

initial_phase_identity_policy: 3existing source attack IDs and original phase1 fields in22 are reused. Only27owns phases2+ and ordinary upgrade prices;22remains creation authority. New character starts learned1 only, no automatic10grant, no second weapon/gift.

targeting.projectile_area: first hostile/solid collision; for area first hostile impact determines2.5m sphere, cap includes impact target; original root primary stays unchanged for procs. Each target unique per root hit, LOS from impact, no wall penetration; ordinary single projectile has no splash
targeting.melee_area: accepted forward90degree cone with explicit reach/height; per ability cap. Original primary first then distance/stableID; no dead target promotion
targeting.range_and_lifetime: 射程气功采用.v1.json accepted effective reach and ceil(reach*60/speed) lifetime; fixed impact radius is not enlarged by射程
targeting.secondary_damage: all these hero profiles explicitly10000; do not borrow ordinary spear5000/灵甲 modifier
targeting.source_target_limits: source explicit cap retained at all phases unless Zhen source explicitly最高阶段+1; Tan天女云游2missing number adopts5 with separate origin field
targeting.zhen_final_phase: only rows whose source says最高阶段+1 get one more target at learned actual phase10; no increase merely because actor ownsphase10but requests lower phase

barrier_recovery.scope: 7Mei自身source rows only; require living compatible active bow, valid current barrier and positive missing amount, no actual recovery封锁; self-only, never health heal or party revive
barrier_recovery.effect: after24step windup once restore min(explicit phase barrier_recovery_amount,current deficit), no attack interval/hit/crit/attack proc; current deficit/block rechecked at effect, late invalid gives0without cost refund
barrier_recovery.precheck: already full/blocked reject before mana/cooldown; no absent barrier state default0
barrier_recovery.source_numeric_semantics: published威力 adopted as flat barrier recovery, not HP damage or percent of maximum; this interpretation is project design
barrier_recovery.modifier_eligibility: 14barrier rules and explicit barrier-effect modifiers only; physician HP-heal passives never inferred from recovery_martial label
barrier_recovery.cooldown_group: one shared barrier_recovery group300steps for all seven named levels/phases; changing skill tier cannot reset it

zhen_cost_policy: all14ordinary attack rows retain explicit blood_attack_300bp life cost from14/22, plus adopted source mana; named狂暴/heal-cost/血魔zero-cost order applies once at accept. HP cost must leave1unless explicit zero override; phase10extra target never adds another payment.
tan_duel_only: 天地回流 sourcePK retained; project chooses one NPCmartial-duel direct attack with source700flat,9stages, no invented automatic reflection/teleport/parry. Ordinary monsters and real player PvP reject; existing缩影 parry remains separate actual reaction.
persistence: learned actual phase, per-phase actual practice/silver paid and rules version; accepted action/phase/effective grade/weapon interval/mana+HP costs/current phase targetcap/random/hit receipts. Ordinary saves wait root/projectiles/derived; activity snapshots retain actual remaining state. Shared barrier group timer and normal cooldown freeze on pause/offline; replay never charges/applies twice.
